findings.text: non-blocking: TabulatedProfile restates the flux-function profile interface (current_density plus its gradient) that DomainProfile already owns at nova/equilibrium/source.py:338, which ContinuedDomainProfile and RotatingDomainProfile extend by subclassing; a tree-registered tabulated callable passed through DomainProfile would have given the scenario node (c) pressure, field-function and rotation primitives for free, whereas this second interface will need its own.

non-blocking: _centroid_height restates the moment-weighted centroid reduction already owned by CurrentCentroidConstraint.booked_height at nova/equilibrium/constraint.py:1093, adding a cell-centre term instead of extending it, so the repository now holds two formulas for the same named quantity and they will drift when either moves.

non-blocking: test_coils_reach_read_residual_and_jacobian asserts the Jacobian equals the identity, which the fixture's zero rows make true whatever the coil contraction does, so a regression dropping driven_operands from step_jacobian (support_read.py:1352) would leave this assertion green even though the test's name claims coils reach the Jacobian; the coil-dependent residual is covered independently, the Jacobian is not.

non-blocking: the certificate retry inside the driven read_batch branch drops the caller's jets and tracking arguments when it re-runs the batch, so a driven batch that supplies jets or tracking and certifies would silently recompute them instead of reusing the caller's values.

non-blocking: the max_steps == 0 early return (and the matching update_path guard at :2274) changes shared solver behaviour for a zero budget, work the node goal does not imply and which only the scenario node's zero-budget negative control needs; it is recorded rather than blocking because it is inside the fenced file and its own test covers it.
non-blocking: the ValueError message spells the knot count as the literal '33' while PROFILE_KNOT_COUNT holds it, so the message will misreport the contract if the constant changes.
